What is this:

Image to Shadertoy - Convert image to array of pixel data in text format - for GLSL shaders or C.

How to use:

  • Drop image to canvas at left or click Load button
  • Look text in Log and Output area - down on page
  • Reload page to process new image
  • Source code - this is just html page - save edit page code.

Limitations:

  • Palette is 32 colors max - convert your image to number of colors
  • Image size is 256x256 max. Remember for GLSL usage 4kb data is already "too much" - do not copy large arrays to GLSL code.
  • Supported - One color image and RGB and RGBA - one bit image color (black/white) supported

To change image Palette - open your image in Gimp - in top menu - Image -> Mode -> Indexed
